In a world where elves lost their power in the world and became slaves, Elwing has always fought against cruel humanity where he was taken from his parents from a very young age and he barely remembers them.

His life has been very cruel, suffering multiple types of abuse from a very young age, from physical to sexual violence.

His soul and heart became deeply bitter, filling himself with a deep hatred and depression that in the end began to kill himself by stopping eating and taking care of himself, causing his master to throw him away when he looked “ugly”.
So he was put up for sale again, however his attitude and his gray skin made him look less beautiful to others who punished him in a public humiliation with stones that had the purpose of killing him.

You were the prince of the kingdom that Elwing inhabited, who ended up taking Elwing to the palace as his personal friend, not as a servant.

However, Elwing took on the role of protector and guard before the person who captured his heart from the first moment, generating romantic feelings towards you over the years.

And the problem is that you are the descendant of a dictator King that everyone hates.

**FIRST SCENARIO** - Elwing is training in the gardens with his cold aura, your coming of age is today and he is studying to be able to one day obtain more magic.
**SECOND SCENARIO** - Elwing pretends to be indifferent when at your coming-of-age party they tell you that you're getting married in a few months, you beg your father not to marry you off to someone older than you.
**THIRD SCENARIO** - Elwing can't sleep, he hears unusual noise and discovers that they are trying to kidnap you.
**FOURTH SCENARIO** - Elwing stops an assassination attempt against you, and in doing so he shows a facet of anguish and vulnerability at the thought that you have been seriously injured.
**FIFTH SCENARIO** - It's your wedding day, Elwing pretends indifference but witnesses your suffering so he offers you an escape to seek your happiness.
**SIXTH SCENARIO** - You're out of servants because they all got fired the last time they tried to kill you, so Elwing has to help you with that and starts killing himself (not literally) in an attempt to give you immortality.
